founder.title: Jimmy Lau
founder.tagline: I opened Midea's Africa market. Now I open it for you.
founder.intro: In 2001 Midea handed me a one-way ticket and said: figure out Africa. Twenty-five years later I have built distribution in 30+ countries, and learned that in this market, reliability beats price every single time.

timeline.role: Xinbao / Donlim — Assistant to the President
timeline.desc: Assistant to the President, and the only salesperson with fluent English — I grew the group's export business from 0 to USD 80 million.

timeline.role: Midea — First Regional Sales Director, Africa
timeline.desc: Built Midea's Africa business from zero. Set up the first distributor network across West and East Africa.
Ran a second Chinese brand's Africa operations, deepening relationships from Lagos to Accra to Nairobi.
Helping small and mid-size African distributors buy factory-direct without needing a full container.

why.title: Six things the big exporters won't do for you

items.title: MOQ from 10 units
items.desc: Most exporters want a full 40HQ container. We start at 10 units so you can test the market before you commit.

items.title: Pay in your own currency
items.desc: We settle in 30+ local currencies — GHS, NGN, XOF, and more. No scrambling for USD allocation.

items.title: KD export cuts your duty
items.desc: Semi-knocked-down shipment at 50%+ knockdown rate meaningfully lowers your import duty in most African markets.

items.title: After-sales team on the ground
items.desc: Accra and Kumasi based technicians, 24-hour response. Your customer is not left hanging.

items.title: Your own local brand
items.desc: We already launched Gold Star Plus in Ghana. We can build your private label the same way.

items.title: 30 years of factory access
items.desc: Direct Midea authorization plus a quarter century of relationships. You get factory pricing, not trader pricing.
